hardware: 1 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (96 GB), g7e.2xlarge
limitations: A projection of this specific fine-tuning scenario, not original foundation pretraining, all DROID data, convergence or a completed full run.
Longest measured point is 400 updates; projection extends it 25 times. Rates exclude the first 20 updates, while the full 500-update scheduler warmup remains intact.
The previous ols/v1 process-time fit failed its slope-consistency gate. Its retained result remains not-estimable; this is a separately disclosed steady-throughput-plus-fixed/v1 calculation.
Low confidence: short measurements and long-run behavior, checkpoint/storage variation and future pricing can change cost. The observed timing spread is not a statistical confidence interval.
The $4/allocation-hour rate is a dated conservative allowance covering the GPU instance, bounded gp3 volume and IPv4; $3.569 is a forecast transfer allowance, not an invoice.

Includes observed boot/setup and finalization/shutdown, ten projected model/optimizer checkpoint saves, and no periodic policy evaluation. Finalization excludes the last measured checkpoint to avoid counting it twice.
Public capture used batch 1 and three episodes; this estimate uses the separately calibrated batch-32, 32-episode recipe.

rate.source: Conservative allocation allowance: AWS Ohio Linux OnDemand g7e.2xlarge is $3.36312/hour (AWS price list published 2026-09-10); remainder allows up to 1 TiB gp3 root storage and one public IPv4 address. Transfer costs require separate evidence. https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonEC2/current/us-east-2/index.json

scope: 10,000-update DROID fine-tuning; first 32 pinned episodes, batch 32, BF16, frozen vision/language backbones, trainable projector/diffusion model, SDPA.
